result.title: The DynaCell Evaluation Suite for Dynamic 3D Virtual Staining of Live Cells
result.comment: 64 pages: 10-page main text with 4 figures and 1 table, plus references and a 49-page appendix with 15 figures and 25 tables. Accepted at NeurIPS 2026, Track on Evaluations and Datasets
result.summary: Understanding how cells respond to perturbations over time is central to cell biology and drug discovery. Live-cell imaging captures the dynamics of perturbation-induced phenotypes in individual cells. While fluorescence imaging can visualize specific molecular phenotypes, labeling and repeated illumination often affect cell health. Virtual staining offers an alternative by predicting these fluorescence images from images acquired without fluorescent labels. Although many virtual staining models have been developed, their performance on volumetric time-lapse data remains poorly characterized. We address this gap with an evaluation suite for 3D time-lapse virtual staining of live cells. The suite combines paired 3D time-lapse images acquired with and without fluorescent labels, a set of baseline models, and three metric tiers measuring pixel-level fidelity, organelle segmentation performance, and single-cell phenotype similarity. Using this evaluation suite, we study metric and model behavior across 3 cell types, 2 microscopes, 4 organelles, and 3 perturbation states. We find that regression baselines better predict the spatial localization of target organelles, whereas the generative baseline better captures the distribution of phenotypes across cells. These differences expose trade-offs between structural and phenotypic fidelity that are obscured by single-metric evaluation and suggest how virtual staining models can be developed for diverse downstream tasks such as localization, segmentation, tracking, and phenotypic profiling. We release the curated datasets, baseline checkpoints, and evaluation code as part of DynaCell, a broader framework for image-based profiling of cell-state dynamics.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文构建了针对活细胞三维延时数据的虚拟染色评测套件，整合配对荧光/无标记图像、基线模型与像素保真、细胞器分割、单细胞表型相似度三层指标，并跨细胞类型、显微镜和扰动状态比较回归与生成基线的表现差异。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作本身不做推理，但其分层评测与「结构保真 vs 表型分布保真」的权衡取舍，可能可供核查：LVR 内部视觉状态评价中细节保留与群体层面分布匹配是否也需要多层级指标而非单一相似度。
